effort-intro-zdr-note.notes: ZDR eligibility note for the effort feature

the-effort-parameter-allows-you-to-contr.notes: Defines effort parameter; states it is GA on all supported models with no beta header

effort-supported-models-note.notes: Lists models that support effort: Mythos Preview, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.5

opus-46-sonnet-46-budget-tokens-tip.notes: budget_tokens deprecated on Opus 4.6/Sonnet 4.6; effort + adaptive thinking is the new recommended pattern

how-effort-works.notes: Default is high effort; max raises it; lowering trades quality for speed/cost

setting-effort-to-high-tip.notes: effort=high is identical to omitting the parameter

the-effort-parameter-affects-all-tokens.notes: Effort affects text, tool calls, AND extended thinking tokens — all three

this-approach-has-two-major-advantages.notes: Two advantages: works without thinking enabled; controls tool-call volume (fewer calls at lower effort)

effort-levels.notes: Canonical table of all five effort levels with descriptions and typical use cases

effort-behavioral-signal-note.notes: Effort is a behavioral signal not a hard token cap; model may still think at low effort on hard problems

recommended-effort-levels-for-sonnet-46.notes: Sonnet 4.6 defaults to high; set explicitly to avoid unexpected latency

sonnet-46-effort-bullets.notes: Prescriptive per-level guidance for Sonnet 4.6: medium recommended default, low for high-volume, max for absolute ceiling

recommended-effort-levels-for-claude-opu.notes: Start with xhigh for coding/agentic; API default is high; xhigh must be set explicitly

opus-47-effort-table.notes: Per-level guidance table for Opus 4.7 including xhigh and max caveats about overthinking

claude-opus-47-respects-effort-more-stri.notes: Opus 4.7 stricter than 4.6 at low/medium; raise effort rather than prompting around shallow reasoning

when-running-claude-opus-47-at-xhigh-or-.notes: At xhigh/max set large max_tokens (start at 64k); model needs room for subagents and tool calls

basic-usage.notes: Multi-language code samples showing output_config.effort in API calls

when-to-adjust-the-effort-parameter.notes: Decision guide for when to use each level; includes model availability notes for max and xhigh

effort-with-tool-use.notes: Lower effort: fewer/combined tool calls, no preamble; higher effort: more calls, plans, comments

effort-with-extended-thinking.notes: Per-model behavior: Mythos/4.7 use adaptive thinking; 4.6 budget_tokens deprecated; 4.5 still uses manual thinking

the-effort-parameter-can-be-used-with-or.notes: Effort controls text and tool tokens even when thinking is not enabled

best-practices.notes: Four best-practice bullets: set explicitly, use low for speed, test per use case, consider dynamic effort
